lead: Robotics is advancing rapidly, with innovations focused on enhancing human interaction and solving complex challenges like dexterous manipulation.

stories.title: Meet the Floating Robot Companion Designed for Safe, Friendly Human Interaction
stories.summary: Researchers are exploring the potential of lighter-than-air robots that can engage in emotional connections with humans. These floating companions are designed to enhance safety and friendliness in human-robot interactions. The project aims to redefine how robots can integrate into social settings, making them more approachable and effective in various environments.

stories.title: China wants to solve the hardest problem in robotics – making hands
stories.summary: China is at the forefront of developing dextrous robotic hands, a significant challenge in the field of robotics. These hands aim to replicate the complex functionality of human hands, which are essential for performing intricate tasks. The race to create 'embodied AI' is heating up, with various companies striving to overcome this final frontier in humanoid robotics.
